Here’s a more polished and professional version that still keeps your warm personality:

:::writing{variant="email" id="58241" subject="Follow-Up & Next Steps with Luxora Collective"}
Hi Mileanet,

Thank you again for your interest in becoming a part of The Luxora Collective! It was great speaking with you today and learning more about your med spa experience, as well as your background with the She Sells Graduate Program.

I’d love to reconnect on Tuesday at 6:30 PM CST to go over additional details and walk you through what the initial two-week trial setter position would look like, along with the potential opportunity to transition into a closing role as you grow within the team.

Aanchal, my amazing assistant and right-hand gal, will be sending over the Zoom invite shortly. In the meantime, if you have any questions, concerns, or specific topics you'd like to discuss beforehand, feel free to email me anytime.

Looking forward to chatting with you on Tuesday!

Best,  
Bethany
:::

:::writing{variant="email" id="41726" subject="Re: Next Steps with Luxora Collective"}
Hi Mileanet,

Thank you so much for your honesty and thoughtful response. I completely understand where you’re coming from, and I actually agree with you. The closer position is absolutely the role we ultimately see you in.

The reason we discussed starting in more of a setter capacity for the first week or so is simply because we want to make sure the messaging is dialed in correctly from the very beginning and that our vision, tone, and process are being relayed exactly the way we intend while we get additional setters into place around you.

This was never meant to be a long-term setter role or a reflection of your experience level. It was more so a short onboarding and immersion period so you could fully understand our ecosystem, offers, and ideal client journey before stepping into closing conversations.

I truly believe your background and skill set are far too strong to stay in a pure setter role long term, which is why I wanted to clarify that piece before we closed the door completely.

Either way, I appreciate your professionalism and transparency, and I’m cheering you on as well.

Best,  
Bethany
:::
